stops.name: Mixnitz
stops.detail: The starting point for a hike is usually the village of Mixnitz with the Mixnitz-Bärenschützklamm railway station.

stops.name: Bahnhof Mixnitz-Bärenschützklamm
stops.detail: From the Mixnitz-Bärenschützklamm station of the Southern Railway in the village of Mixnitz, past the parking lot, one walks for a good hour along the educational trail dedicated to Archduke Johann, past display boards to the Hans-Kerl-Hütte with the ticket office at the beginning of the climbing facility.

stops.name: Bärenschützklamm
stops.detail: The Bärenschützklamm in the Austrian state of Styria is a gorge with limestone cliffs up to 300 m high.

stops.name: Mixnitzbach
stops.detail: It is located in the Graz Highlands in the area of the municipality of Pernegg an der Mur and is traversed by the Mixnitzbach, which flows approximately southwestward from the left into the Mur.

stops.name: Zentralalpenweg
stops.detail: The Central Alpine Trail, an Austrian long-distance hiking trail from Hainburg an der Donau (Lower Austria) to Feldkirch in Vorarlberg, also runs through the gorge.
